representativeModel.formFactor: stand-alone automated microplate incubator with a full front user door, upper robotic gate, and nominal 1000 mm transfer/loading tray height

notes: A vendor STEP download was found for the representative STX220-SA, but no practical STEP-to-STL conversion toolchain is available in this workspace, so the delivered mesh is a composite STL fallback.
The fallback follows the official STX220-SA outer envelope and uses vendor imagery plus flush-gate/transfer-height documentation to estimate the upper robotic gate and protruding loading tray.

accessFrames.name: front-user-door
accessFrames.description: Estimated manual front access point centered on the full-sized user door for plate loading and service access.
accessFrames.collision_notes: The simplified cabinet collision leaves a front body cutout through the main door region so approach to this body-mounted access frame is not blocked by a solid front wall.

accessFrames.name: loading-tray
accessFrames.description: Estimated robotic tray handoff point aligned with the representative upper flush gate and 1000 mm transfer height.
accessFrames.collision_notes: This access frame is mounted on a dedicated loading tray link, with the tray collision modeled in a fixed fully extended pose outside the body shell.

accessFrames.name: lower-control-panel
accessFrames.description: Estimated operator access point for the lower-right display and control cluster visible in the representative STX220-SA front image.
accessFrames.collision_notes: The front cutout used for body access keeps this main-body service/control approach reachable without routing through the simplified cabinet shell.
